seo.title: Sustainability & ESG
seo.description: Understand what sustainability and ESG mean for your daily life — and how reducing solar heat in vehicles, homes and buildings lowers energy use, cuts carbon emissions and builds a greener future.

data.subhead: Sustainability is more than a buzzword — it is how the energy we use every day shapes our climate, our costs and our quality of life. Learn what ESG means and how one small change to your glass can make a measurable difference.

media.alt: Wide split scene: an EV on a green hillside road, a modern home and a glass office tower under bright tropical sun — conveying mobility + buildings + environment together.

pillars.title: Environmental
pillars.description: How our energy use, emissions and waste affect the planet. Cooling is one of the largest energy loads in ASEAN — reducing solar heat gain directly reduces electricity and fuel demand.

pillars.title: Social
pillars.description: How choices affect people — health, comfort and well-being. Blocking UV and HEV blue light protects skin and eyes; cooler cabins and rooms reduce heat stress for families and employees.

pillars.title: Governance
pillars.description: How organisations commit to responsible, measurable practices. Energy-efficiency upgrades like window film contribute to ESG reporting and green building certifications such as GBI.
